3. Positive definite functions
In this section, we investigate real-valued functions whose Fourier coeﬃcients are all non-negative.
These functions, known as positive deﬁnite functions, play a crucial role in harmonic analysis on
groups [7, 8, 32]. To begin with, we summarize several basic properties of functions on ﬁnite abelian
groups in the following lemma.
